title: Project knowledge/gap MCP writes ride the checkout-owner backchannel; commit to publish
content: Project-scoped knowledge and gap MCP writes (bbox_learn/bbox_remember/bbox_decide/bbox_forget, bbox_gap family, bbox_review, bbox_knowledge_link) on cutover-covered projects ride the checkout-mutation backchannel: the daemon validates and enqueues the exact .bbox/ file bytes, the checkout-owner collector applies them within one cycle. The tool response names the landing path; commit the delivered file with your change to publish it. Never hand-author .bbox/knowledge or .bbox/gaps records; if the lane errors, surface it rather than falling back to manual JSON.
